recommendation: 9 main PRs with a tenth in reserve; do not combine sort, aggregates, SMJ and windows into one large native PR merely to reduce the count.

groups.scope: Spark/Scala baseline, pristine DF vendor, Delta/GCP ADC/planning, release builder/publisher.
groups.internal_review_plan: Within one PR, first Spark/Delta on stock DF55.2; then a separate pristine vendor commit, root patch/shared lock/explicit vendor tests and repeat validation; then release tooling. All stages are reviewable commits without Joom algorithms in vendor. Earlier separate PRs are combined; checks are not reduced.

internal_stages.name: Spark/Delta on stock DataFusion
internal_stages.scope: Configure exact Spark4.2.1/Scala2.13.18 and Delta4.4.1, minimal GCP ADC/planning adaptations; use stock registry DataFusion55.2.0 crates with the current target lock's Arrow/Parquet59.3.2. Obtain baseline Comet/Delta/ANSI fixture results before vendoring.
internal_stages.validation: Effective POM and actual test Spark version; baseline native/Delta/schema/DV/rebase/DPP results and expected errors. No Joom DataFusion patches.

internal_stages.name: Pristine vendor in a separate commit
internal_stages.scope: Import the published standalone datafusion-physical-plan55.2.0 with provenance/checksum/license in a separate mechanical commit. Do not port the old Cargo55.1 or inherit Comet workspace.version1.2.0; the crate name/version remains datafusion-physical-plan55.2.0.
internal_stages.validation: Sources match pristine55.2; no Joom algorithmic diff.

internal_stages.name: Connect vendor and a separate test target
internal_stages.scope: Configure the root patch and include the vendored crate in the native workspace with an explicit unit/regression test target. Use shared native/Cargo.lock/root patch; membership alone or cargo test --manifest-path is insufficient.
internal_stages.validation: Verify the resolved graph: release Comet and vendor tests use a single local physical-plan55.2.0 identity, runtime DF55.2/Arrow59.3.2. Unit-test dev dependencies may add lock entries, but must not arbitrarily update the runtime graph. CI explicitly selects the package; Comet-only default-members do not imply running vendor unit tests.

internal_stages.name: Repeat validation and release tooling
internal_stages.scope: Repeat baseline checks after replacing the registry crate with a pristine path crate. Prepare build-release.sh/publish-jfrog.sh, multiarch packaging/provenance; separately verify upstream native-library reload.
internal_stages.validation: Compare before/after-vendoring results and plans, explicitly run vendor unit/regression tests and Comet/Delta suites, verify libcomet packaging/GLIBC/Scala. G01 produces an internal RC1; the full Joom capability set is not yet ported.

groups.scope: Offsets/FFI, TaskContext, block ownership, cancellation, timestamp compatibility.
groups.internal_review_plan: First shared types/offsets, then off-thread context, block lifecycle, cancellation, timestamp regressions/residuals. Validate each stage before the next; generic ANSI arithmetic/cast gaps belong here.
Separate commits for reserve1/32, SpillWorkspace, wide sort and JVM handoff1/4; one PR allows the final memory lifecycle to be tested without intermediate inconsistent APIs.

groups.scope: Upstream aggregate parity, spill/offset/emit/drain, collect_list, FIRST/LAST/bool/string-value MIN_BY/MAX_BY, SortAggregate.
groups.internal_review_plan: D08+N09 remain a single coordinated substep. Other changes use separate commits; preserve state/overflow guards. Residual SUM/AVG ANSI fixes and their tests belong to this PR.

groups.scope: Filter-before-payload, outer-join correctness, one-side hoisting and ANSI eligibility.
groups.internal_review_plan: First filter plus all mandatory outer-join correctness fixes, then hoisting with can-throw/lazy checks. Integrate the complete safe block, not a temporary incorrect outer-join version.

groups.scope: Spillable partition windows, tiny-partition batching and SortedWindow.
groups.internal_review_plan: Three independent review/test stages within one branch. OffsetBudget already exists. Preserve FILTER fallback, RANGE/ANSI/ordering and required distribution.

groups.scope: C2R borrowing/pool, BHJ/Kryo/offsets, writer optimizations/spill, direct read and coalescer.
groups.internal_review_plan: Not one monolithic commit: C2R+pool; broadcast; writers; spill callback; initial direct read; JVM/native/proto coalescer. Check ownership and buffer lifetime after every step. This is the broadest interop block; if the diff becomes objectively unreviewable, use the reserve split instead of sacrificing review.

groups.scope: Scalar runtime arguments, JVM short-circuit, UDF pools, plan/task serialization; necessary native expression evaluation-order fixes.
groups.internal_review_plan: Sequential commits for JVM dispatch/pools/serialization; shaded-artifact tests. Native ANSI issue7246 is broader than J06: identify necessary fixes in separate commits within this PR; do not mix in excluded PR5889.

groups.scope: BoundaryFormats, wide-row fallback and calibrated cost model together.
groups.internal_review_plan: Port the shared code as a coherent whole immediately: no temporary standaloneConversionCount stage without EngineCostModel. Preserve the final table from tag13. Run the complete cost on/off/AQE/mixed-hash/native-coverage matrix after all native capabilities.

reserve.scope: Cross-feature tests and necessary bounded integration fixes in separate commits. If controlling the diff objectively requires splitting one of the 9 blocks, the reserve may be reassigned to that split after discussing the concrete boundary. Do not create an unnecessary empty PR.

C01.note: Arithmetic/cast/division ANSI correctness; no extra branch beyond the limit.

C02.note: Native evaluation order/JVM dispatch compatibility; do not claim J06 fully resolves issue7246.

Q01.note: Additional cross-feature qualification if a separate diff is needed.

historical_only.H01: Do not restore rules reverted before tag13; no separate feature branch is needed.

quality_controls: The 40 old packages remain an internal checklist of scope, dependencies and checks, rather than 40 PRs.
Each large PR has atomic commits/meaningful substeps, with checks after them rather than a single test run at the end.
A single enormous squash commit without reviewable structure is not proposed; retain informative history.
During review, clearly separate mechanical vendor import from manual changes; provenance/hashes are recorded in the register.
Overall CI/feature/runtime/ANSI gates are not reduced. Fix or restrict a known unsafe-result path before production.
If a package cannot objectively be reviewed well at this size, do not combine further merely to meet the limit; show the concrete diff and propose a split within the reserve.
Do not leave C01/C02/C03/Q01 as 4 hidden extra PRs: their owners are explicitly assigned in the table.
Qualify G09 after all of G03-G08. Groups follow the main sequential order; parallel implementation is not required.

benefits: Fewer CI/rebase/merge cycles without losing scope.
Removes artificial temporary boundaries between BoundaryFormats and the cost model.
Integrates a complete related capability together with regressions.
costs: Review is larger and isolating a bug inside a block is harder; therefore atomic commits/substeps are needed.
G01 includes a large mechanical vendor import; G04/G06/G07 may produce substantial diffs. Assess their reviewability from the actual patch, not a promise.

milestones.meaning: Internal baseline build; not the complete Joom migration.
Shared runtime mechanisms/native block are ready; remaining JVM/shuffle/planner work is still incomplete.
Complete candidate with known unsafe-result paths fixed/restricted.
The same commit as the latest successful RC; no unverified changes.

unchanged_policies: ANSI=true; compare Spark4.2.1 without/with Comet on identical inputs, checking results and expected errors.
Use upstream wherever possible; preserve all missing Joom parts.
Do not touch or include PR5889.
RC tags are immutable; additional attempts consume the next number, shifting later planned numbers.
Tag/build/JFrog publication/production rollout are separate actions.
authorization: Work sessions and local Git operations are authorized; network access is subject to the safety condition. At this historical planning snapshot the latest instruction prohibited coding until a new task, so only documentation and read-only preparation were allowed. Push, publication and production were excluded. Later G01 authorizations are recorded in decisions.json.
approval_quote: Agreed; record the plan of 9 PRs with a tenth in reserve.

step2_relationship.replacement: Separate stages and commits within G01. The technical order stock DF -> pristine vendor -> same-graph vendor tests is preserved.

algorithm_ports.G03: Sort/spill vendor patches together with Comet wiring.
algorithm_ports.G04: Aggregate vendor patches together with Comet functions/state guards.
algorithm_ports.G05: SMJ vendor patches together with eligibility/correctness tests.

delivery_scope.goal: Implement the agreed migration and produce local Comet and Delta integration JAR artifacts for the user to include in the Spark4.2 image.
delivery_scope.checks: Mandatory correctness/ANSI/regression/integration and packaging checks remain. Final JARs must have SHA256, Git SHA and build details. The user will separately validate real production GCP jobs.
delivery_scope.user_quote: For now, we need to complete everything planned so that I receive JAR artifacts to include in our Spark 4.2 image. I will check performance later.

performance_policy.user_quote: Of course, check performance as far as you can during implementation where possible.
performance_policy.during_implementation: Use existing Scala microbenchmarks/Spark Benchmark, Rust Criterion and available TPC-H/DS runners in the established style. Extend the relevant benchmark normally if necessary; do not create separate infrastructure for the migration.
performance_policy.production_benchmarks: Full measurements on real GCP jobs are deferred to user validation and are not a current condition for handing over local JARs.
performance_policy.latest_user_quote: For performance evaluation, follow exactly the established practice in the datafusion-comet project. Do not create special tests if nothing similar has existed there.
